take.title_zh: AI 公司直攻應用層，設計工具版圖重組
take.title_en: AI Labs Move Up the Stack, Redrawing the Design Tool Map
take.body_zh:
本週最大的產業訊號不是新模型，而是 Anthropic 正式跨入設計工具市場。Claude Design 的目標並非搶奪專業設計師，而是讓不懂 Figma 的 PM、行銷與創辦人也能直接產出原型，這重新定義了「誰有資格做設計」。

Figma 的迅速反擊，加上 Adobe 原有的市場基礎，顯示這將是一場多方混戰而非單一贏家的局面。對設計師而言，真正該關注的不是工具之爭，而是團隊分工與協作模式即將如何被重寫。
take.body_en:
This week's biggest signal wasn't a new model — it was Anthropic formally entering the design-tool market. Claude Design isn't aimed at professional designers; it's built for PMs, marketers, and founders who've never touched Figma, redefining who gets to "do design" in the first place.

Figma's fast counter-move, layered on top of Adobe's existing footprint, suggests this will be a multi-way scramble rather than a single winner. For designers, the real story isn't which tool wins — it's how team roles and collaboration models are about to be rewritten.

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Design，挑戰 Figma 設計工具地位
articles.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Design, Challenging Figma
articles.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出全新 AI 設計工具 Claude Design，可將自然語言提示直接轉換為互動原型、簡報與行銷素材，目前以研究預覽形式開放付費 Claude 訂閱用戶使用，底層採用 Claude Opus 模型。此工具鎖定對象並非長期使用 Figma 的專業設計師，而是產品經理、行銷人員、創辦人與開發者等原本需要學習 Figma 或倚賴設計師協助的族群。消息一出立即衝擊 Figma 股價，也讓兩家原本合作的公司關係轉趨緊張。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Design, an AI tool that turns natural-language prompts into interactive prototypes, slide decks, and marketing assets. Now in research preview for paid Claude subscribers and built on Claude's Opus model, the tool doesn't target professional Figma power users — it's aimed at product managers, marketers, founders, and developers who currently rely on Figma or a designer's help. The launch sent Figma's stock tumbling and exposed rising tension between the two companies.
articles.take_zh: 當 AI 公司開始跨界做設計工具，設計師該思考的不是「會不會被取代」，而是「不懂 Figma 的人現在能做什麼」。工具民主化正在改寫團隊分工的界線。
articles.take_en: When an AI lab starts shipping design tools, the real question isn't whether designers get replaced — it's who else can now prototype without one. Tool democratization is quietly redrawing team boundaries.

articles.title_zh: Figma 推出自有 AI 設計助手，正面迎戰 Anthropic
articles.title_en: Figma Builds Its Own AI Assistant to Counter Anthropic
articles.summary_zh: 面對 Anthropic Claude Design 帶來的壓力，Figma 加快腳步推出自有 AI 設計助手，可直接在畫布上與使用者協作生成設計。這是 Figma 從單純設計工具，擴大為涵蓋產品、行銷與內容團隊的完整工作流程平台策略的一環，旗下已有 Figma Make、Draw、Sites、Buzz 等多項新產品線，試圖將觸角伸向更多非專業設計背景的使用者。
articles.summary_en: In response to competitive pressure from Anthropic's Claude Design, Figma is rolling out its own AI assistant that can collaborate with users directly on the canvas. The move fits Figma's broader strategy of evolving from a single design tool into a workflow hub spanning product, marketing, and content teams — following recent launches like Figma Make, Draw, Sites, and Buzz aimed at non-designer users.
articles.take_zh: Figma 的反應速度顯示產業競爭已從「功能比拼」轉為「陣營卡位」。當設計工具開始互搶彼此的使用者群，PM 與行銷人員將是最大受益者。
articles.take_en: Figma's rapid response shows competition has shifted from feature parity to territory control. As design tools poach each other's users, PMs and marketers stand to benefit most.

articles.title_zh: 設計工具混戰升溫：Adobe、Figma 與 Anthropic 三方角力
articles.title_en: The Design Tool Wars Heat Up: Adobe, Figma, and Anthropic Collide
articles.summary_zh: 隨著 Anthropic 跨足設計工具市場，原本由 Adobe 與 Figma 主導的產業版圖出現新變數。報導指出，Anthropic 今年第一季在生成式 AI 軟體的企業支出占比已達 37%，超越 OpenAI 的 33%，顯示其不僅在模型層面領先，如今更試圖將優勢延伸至應用層，直接挑戰既有設計軟體龍頭的市場地位。
articles.summary_en: Anthropic's expansion into design software is reshaping a market long dominated by Adobe and Figma. Reports note Anthropic captured 37% of enterprise generative-AI software spending in Q1 2026, ahead of OpenAI's 33% — evidence its edge is no longer confined to the model layer. The company is now pushing that advantage into applications, directly challenging established design-tool incumbents.
articles.take_zh: 模型公司開始吃應用層的午餐，這對所有「AI 包裝層」新創都是警訊。當底層模型商自己下場做產品，中間層的護城河會更快被侵蝕。
articles.take_en: Model providers moving into the application layer is a warning sign for every AI-wrapper startup. When foundation labs ship their own products, the middle layer's moat erodes faster.
